findings.title: Plan documents are empty scaffolds still marked active
findings.why: The three plan files (1-2, 1-3, 1-4) contain only the placeholder comment. Their status is `active` although the matching tasks are `approved` and done, so they record no plan.

findings.title: Scaffold placeholder comment left in task documents
findings.why: Tasks 001 and 004 still carry the template comment telling the author to replace it. Tasks 002 and 003 have it removed.

findings.title: rename reports invalid-input before not-found
findings.why: `rename` validates the new title before it looks up the task. Renaming a missing task to an invalid title returns `invalid-input` instead of `not-found`. This is harmless but inconsistent with `tag`, which also validates first, and with the other methods.
